name:
Sonora Resort
All-Inclusive
insider_take: A floating wilderness paradise where killer whales cruise past your dinner table and grizzly bears fish for salmon just steps from your luxury suite.
whats_special: This exclusive Relais & Châteaux eco-resort sits on a remote island in British Columbia's pristine Discovery Islands, accessible only by seaplane or helicopter. The all-inclusive property features world-class whale watching, helicopter adventures to untouched glaciers, and some of the planet's best salmon fishing—all while maintaining luxury standards with gourmet dining and spa treatments.
pro_tip: Book during late summer (August-September) for the incredible salmon runs when you can watch grizzly bears fishing from the resort's viewing platforms, plus enjoy the warmest weather for outdoor activities.
dont_miss: The guided zodiac excursions through the surrounding archipelago where resident orca pods frequently surface alongside your boat, and the resort's signature "Grizzly Bear Breakfast" experience where you dine overlooking Glendale River as massive coastal brown bears hunt for salmon below.
pros: Stunning remote island location with pristine nature
cons: Remote location requires seaplane or boat access
